contract.closure_recursion: only source paths ending .sources.json are traversed; prose citations and executable imports are not inferred edges
contract.edge: each recursive JSON dict with string commit/path, counted once per occurrence in each visited manifest version
contract.manifest_version: ordered pair (commit,path), even if the Git blob is reused
contract.scope: workflow/provenance only; not a scientific theorem or full test-suite replay
contract.source_access: git --no-replace-objects show at exact commits; no release-worktree reads

interpreter_plan.ball_runtime: pinned native-xi-pass3-runtime Python with flint and mpmath; no sympy or numpy
interpreter_plan.other_runtime: system Python3.12 with sympy and mpmath; no flint

remote_reachability_observation.method: git ls-remote origin exact named heads, followed by local object ancestry
remote_reachability_observation.scope: historical observation only; offline replay authenticates object ancestry, not current advertisement
